latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of koompi-nonprofit skill for nonprofits and NGOs.

- Supports donor management, grant tracking, fundraising campaigns, volunteer coordination, program impact measurement, board governance, event planning, fund accounting, compliance reporting, and stakeholder communications.
- "Heartbeat" feature to alert on upcoming grant deadlines, pending donor acknowledgments, overdue pledge payments, unfilled volunteer shifts, and board meeting prep.
- Provides structured processes and data formats for donor and grant lifecycles.
- Includes detailed guidance on campaign planning, donor stewardship, and grant reporting.
- Designed to streamline operations and ensure compliance and strong stakeholder relationships.
